ideas.title: Investigating Election Fraud in Georgia
ideas.description: This story would investigate the ongoing FBI investigation into possible election fraud in Fulton County, Georgia, and explore the potential impact on the democratic process.
questions: What evidence is the FBI looking for in the investigation?
How widespread is election fraud in Georgia and other states?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the importance of election integrity. I would recommend starting by reviewing FBI documents and interviewing witnesses, and then expanding the investigation to other states and jurisdictions.

ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the Philadelphia men who pleaded guilty to using AI to fabricate records.
questions: How widespread is Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and other states?
What steps are being taken to prevent and detect Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to highlight the human impact of Medicaid fraud and the need for increased scrutiny and enforcement. I would recommend starting by reviewing Medicaid records and interviewing witnesses, and then expanding the investigation to other states and jurisdictions.
